proposals.before: Qin, wife of Wang De of Ren County, Jizhou; Song, wife of Wu Kan of Jinhua County, Wuzhou Route; Zhang, wife of Gao of Luzhou Route; Shalin, wife of Yuehunan of Ganzhou Route; Li, wife of Wanyan Tiego's household in Gaizhou — all honored for steadfast integrity.
proposals.after: Qin, wife of Wang De of Ren County, Jizhou; Song, wife of Wu Kan of Jinhua County, Wuzhou Route; Zhang, wife of Gao Ren of Luzhou Route; Shalin, wife of Yuehunan of Ganzhou Route; Li, wife of Wanyan Tiego's household in Gaizhou — all honored for steadfast integrity.
proposals.reason: Chinese has 高仁; the idiomatic English drops the given name Ren.

proposals.before: Sixth month, on jihai new moon, an edict proclaimed throughout the court and commonwealth the crimes of Yelu Temür and others, and amnestied the realm.
proposals.after: Sixth month, on jihai new moon, an edict proclaimed throughout the court and commonwealth the crimes of Yuelu Temür and others, and amnestied the realm.
proposals.reason: Same person as 月魯帖木兒 earlier rendered Yuelu Temür; Yelu is an inconsistent transliteration.

proposals.before: On xinmao day, the Minister of Works seal was again granted to Wan'an Temple monk Yanxiangji.
proposals.after: On xinmao day, the Minister of Works seal was again granted to Wan'an Temple monk Yan Jixiang.
proposals.reason: 嚴吉祥 is surname Yan + dharma name Jixiang; Yanxiangji fuses the order.

proposals.before: On wushen day, Yunnan Branch Secretariat said: "Tongzhou local official Ase and Heli of Hexi and others, together with 1,500 Luoluo bandit troops, raided Bulong Village in Huizhou Route;
proposals.after: On wushen day, Yunnan Branch Secretariat said: "Tongzhou local official Ase and Ale of Hexi and others, together with 1,500 Luoluo bandit troops, raided Bulong Village in Huizhou Route;
proposals.reason: 阿勒 is better read Ale; Heli is an unsupported reading of the same characters.

proposals.before: Ordered relevant offices to build a living shrine for Bayan, erect a merit monument at Zhuozhou; separately build shrine and monument at Bianliang.
proposals.after: Ordered relevant offices to build a living shrine for Bayan and erect a merit monument at Zhuozhou, and separately to build a shrine and monument at Bianliang.
proposals.reason: Chinese 伯別建祠 is 別建 ('separately build') continuing the Bayan commission; the English is acceptable but the Chinese 伯 is likely a graphic slip before 別.

proposals.before: Moreover he secretly schemed to pass the throne to his son, fabricating wicked words and shifting blame onto Empress Budashiri, saying the Emperor was not Mingzong's son, and thereby caused exile to remote regions.
proposals.after: Moreover he secretly schemed to pass the throne to his son, fabricating wicked words and shifting blame onto Empress Babusha, saying the Emperor was not Mingzong's son, and thereby caused exile to remote regions.
proposals.reason: Chinese 八不沙 is Babusha (Mingzong's empress), not Budashiri (不答失裏); the translation conflates two different empresses.

proposals.before: Moreover he secretly schemed to pass the throne to his son, fabricating wicked words and shifting blame onto Empress Budashiri, saying the Emperor was not Mingzong's son, and thereby caused exile to remote regions.
proposals.after: Moreover he secretly schemed to pass the throne to his son, fabricating wicked words and shifting blame onto Empress Babusha, saying the Emperor was not Mingzong's son, and thereby caused exile to remote regions.
proposals.reason: Chinese 八不沙 is Babusha, distinct from 不答失裏 (Budashiri) appearing later; literal English must not reuse Budashiri here.

proposals.before: Wenzong's evil deepened without repentance; at the moment when he should have gone in person to welcome him, he with his ministers Yelu Buhua, Yili Yali, Mingli Dong'a, and others plotted treason, causing our imperial father to die with resentment as the honored guest on high.
proposals.after: Wenzong's evil deepened without repentance; at the moment when he should have gone in person to welcome him, he with his ministers Yolu Buhua, Yili Yali, Mingli Dong'a, and others plotted treason, causing our imperial father to die with resentment as the honored guest on high.
proposals.reason: 月魯不花 is not the Khitan surname 耶律 (Yelu); Yelu misreads the Mongolian name 月魯不花.

decisions.reason: The source explicitly gives the husband's full name as 高仁, Gao Ren; the existing English drops his given name.
月魯帖木兒 is the same man translated as Yuelu Temür in s0096. Yelu would represent the unrelated surname 耶律.
嚴吉祥 is Yan Jixiang. The existing Yanxiangji transposes and fuses the name's final characters.
The source names 阿勒, Ale; Heli does not represent those characters and conflicts with the extraction's correctly identified person.
The proposal supplies the conjunctions and articles needed to make the two coordinated shrine-and-stele commands grammatical in English without changing their meaning.
